Deputy for Val-de-Marne's 7th constituency. Sat on the Committee on Foreign Affairs (2024-2025). Served as spokesperson of the Droite Republicaine group. Seat ended upon entering government (succeeded by his substitute Nicolas Tryzna).

role: Minister of the City and Housing (Ministre de la Ville et du Logement)
description: Appointed full minister of the City and Housing in the second Lecornu government on 12 October 2025; retained the portfolio in the 26 February 2026 reshuffle. Associated with the 'statut du bailleur prive' rental-investment incentive (dispositif Jeanbrun).
Author of a book published by Albin Michel; HATVP declares net remuneration of 33,587 EUR for 2023.
